label: .removeIsRepeatable: a random seed makes the same remove give different pixels
.healCopiesFromSource: the offset read backwards samples the wrong side
.healSkipsOffCanvasSource: heal passes the whole stroke to core, which throws on an off-canvas source
find: try reachable.intersect(sourceOnCanvas(width: pixels.width, height: pixels.height, offset: sourceOffset))

label: .healClipsBothAxes: the clip reads the offset's sign backwards on x, keeping the off-canvas columns
find: let x0 = max(0, -dx), x1 = min(width, width - dx)
replace: let x0 = max(0, dx), x1 = min(width, width + dx)

label: .healClipsBothAxes: the clip ignores the vertical offset
find: let y0 = max(0, -dy), y1 = min(height, height - dy)
